symptom: `mxcli init --tool cursor` (and aider, continue, copilot, vibe, windsurf) installed no Starlark lint rules, so `mxcli lint` ran the built-in Go rules alone; a project copy without .claude/ did the same. No notice, exit 0: 210 findings from 17 rules read as cleaner than 1,984 from 49.
cause: init wrote .claude/lint-rules/ only inside the claude and opencode branches, although the lint config next to it was already written outside the per-tool branches for exactly this reason; projectLintRules treated a missing rules directory as an empty one without saying so.
insight: Anything `mxcli lint` reads is tool-independent and belongs outside the per-tool branches of init; test it by iterating SupportedTools, not by naming the tools that happen to work. A smaller rule set is indistinguishable from a cleaner project in every output, so any path that runs fewer rules than it could must say so on stderr.
